ul.li: Add fs::Dir directory-relative operations on Unix and Windows.
Add macOS signal support and more named Unix signals.
Keep installed signal handlers for the process lifetime.
Support pidfd_wait with older libc headers.
Remove BTreeMap full-tree debug checks from mutations.
Fix filesystem I/O namespace lookup on Windows.
Add random sources, Mersenne Twister engines, SeedSeq and distributions.
Add BudgetAllocator and fallible Box and Arc construction with try_make.
Add signal subscriptions and async Ctrl+C, including Windows support.
Add async Mutex and future by_ref.
Add Unix process group extensions and Linux PidFd support.
Add JSON Reader, quote_string, numeric comparison and Value serde support.
Add benchmark Suite, Runner, allocation diagnostics and cppstd comparisons.
Extend floating-point math and fix shortest decimal tie breaking.
Fix TOML Unicode serialization and aligned allocation for small alignments.
Fix reactor readiness and epoll deregistration.
Add hexadecimal and octal integer formatting.
Add instant duration since monotonic origin.
Fix OS string display in argparse errors.
